Container.Name: Deduplarr
Container.Overview: Deduplarr is a Plex duplicate cleanup companion with an arr-style web UI for reviewing duplicate movie and episode versions before choosing what to keep.
Container.Description: Deduplarr connects to Plex through the Plex API, scans selected movie, show, and video libraries for duplicate media versions, displays file paths and stream details, scores each version, and supports manual or automatic keeper selection. Plex URL and token are configured in the app Settings page and stored under /config. The default login is admin/admin; change it after first sign-in. Delete actions ask Plex to delete the selected media part, so Plex media deletion and filesystem write access must be enabled in Plex.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Container 7889 - Host port for the Deduplarr web UI

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Stores Deduplarr settings, saved Plex connection details, auth configuration, and keep preferences

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Optional long random value used to sign Deduplarr login sessions. Leave blank to generate one at startup; set it to keep sessions valid across container recreation.
